name: Rib Vaulting
desc: Looking up into a gothic rib vault as the nave walks past overhead — true groin-vault geometry springs from the piers, diagonal ribs cross at a carved boss in every bay, ashlar courses band the severies and a slow light crawls the stone from clerestory to clerestory.

energy.doc: light amplitude, glow and camera sway

scale.doc: nave width and vault rise (2.4 = a colossal wide vault filling the frame; Z spacing is fixed so this is never a no-op)

density.doc: how many bays recede down the nave

rise.doc: vault crown height vs half-span — flat romanesque to soaring gothic

x.doc: vanishing point x as canvas fraction

y.doc: eye level as canvas fraction — high values put the camera under the vault looking up

style.doc: aesthetic: coursed limestone mass / painted medieval polychrome cells / cyan schematic line drawing / hatched engraved plate / pure chiaroscuro — only the lit ribs, cells swallowed by black

seed.doc: deterministic seed for cell tone, boss carving and dead clerestories
